events.text: Leahy was on the battleship when she made her famous dash through the Strait of Magellan and around South America in the spring of 1898.
events.subject: self
events.quote: around South America in the spring of 1898

events.text: The battleship participated in the Battle of Santiago on July 3 during the Spanish–American War.
events.subject: self
events.quote: to participate in the Battle of Santiago on July 3 during the Spanish–American War

events.text: Leahy was commissioned Ensign on July 1, 1899.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Leahy was commissioned Ensign on July 1 , 1899

events.text: He returned to the United States in 1902 and became a member of the Military Order of the Dragon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He returned to the United States in 1902 and became a member of the Military Order of the Dragon

events.text: Beginning in 1907, he served as instructor in the Department of Physics and Chemistry for two years.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Beginning in 1907 , he served as instructor in the Department of Physics and Chemistry for two years

events.text: He went to sea in 1909 and served as navigator of the armored cruiser in the Pacific Fleet.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He went to sea in 1909 and served as navigator of the armored cruiser in the Pacific Fleet

events.text: On October 18, 1911, Lt. Cmdr. Leahy served as naval aide to President William Howard Taft at the laying of the keel at Mare Island.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On October 18 , 1911 , Lt . Cmdr . Leahy served as naval aide to President William Howard Taft

events.text: During the American Occupation of Nicaragua in 1912, he was Chief of Staff to the Commander, Naval Forces there.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During the American Occupation of Nicaragua in 1912 , he was Chief of Staff to the Commander

events.text: Late in 1912, he came ashore in Washington as Assistant Director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competitions.
events.subject: self
events.object: Assistant Director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competitions
events.quote: Late in 1912 , he came ashore in Washington as Assistant Director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competitions

events.text: In 1913, he was assigned to the Bureau of Navigation as a detail officer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1913 , he was assigned to the Bureau of Navigation as a detail officer

events.text: He was in that assignment in early 1917 in West Indian waters and had additional duty as Senior Aide on the Staff of Commander Squadron Three of the Patrol Force Atlantic Fleet.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was in that assignment in early 1917 in West Indian waters and had additional duty as Senior Aide

events.text: In April 1918 he went to command, formerly Princess Alice, transporting troops to France.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in April 1918 went to command , formerly Princess Alice , transporting troops to France

events.text: After a short cruise in that command, he came ashore in 1918 and served for three years as director of Gunnery Exercises and Engineering Competition in the Navy Department.
